programme.title: Life on Air: David Attenborough's 50 Years in Television
programme.desc: David Attenborough is one of Britain's best-known TV personalities, having presented programmes - usually about animals or natural history - for decades. Actor Michael Palin presents this special that takes a look back at the TV legend's career, using classic clips, outtakes and anecdotes to highlight Attenborough's work. `Life on Air' also interviews Attenborough and some key figures in his life, including his brother, actor Richard Attenborough. David also welcomes viewers into his home and on the set as he works on one of his programmes.

programme.title: Attenborough and the Giant Dinosaur
programme.desc: David Attenborough tells the story of the discovery and reconstruction in Argentina of the world's largest known dinosaur, a brand new species of titanosaur. Measuring 37m long - close to four London buses put end to end - and weighing 70 metric tons, it now holds the record as the biggest animal ever to walk the earth.

programme.title: Jonathan Dimbleby: My Father and Belsen

programme.title: Richard Dimbleby at Belsen
programme.desc: In this film from 1965, broadcaster Richard Dimbleby returns to Belsen, 20 years after his first radio account of the liberation of the concentration camp.

programme.title: After the Battle
programme.desc: In the series following former war reporters as they return to past battlefields, Richard Dimbleby goes back to Germany.

programme.title: What They Found
programme.desc: Following the story of two members of the British Army's Film and Photographic Unit who accompanied the troops liberating the Bergen-Belsen concentration camp.

programme.title: Quentin Blake: The Drawing of My Life
programme.desc: Quentin Blake turns 89 in December 2021. His first book was published 61 years ago, and over 500 volumes later, he is still hard at work, drawing every day and determined to break down the barriers between illustration and `fine arts'. Blake shares his pleasure in the blank page, the scratch of a quill, and the enjoyable mischief and chaos of childhood.
